local.b: Opponent John McKinney appeared to concede Thursday as Roy held a lead of more than two to one.
local.title: Roy wins LA city attorney's race

local.b: The company spent more than $4.1 million backing Mayor Karen Bass and $2.1 million for city attorney candidate John McKinney. Bass conceded to Nithya Raman on Thursday.
local.title: Airbnb poured more than $6M into the LA mayoral and city attorney races. Its candidates lost

local.h: Nithya Raman defeats Karen Bass for LA mayor
local.b: The councilmember and DSA member beat the incumbent with a message of hope for a city beset by crises.

goodnews.b: Cameras caught a coyote twice on the Wallis Annenberg Wildlife Crossing in Agoura Hills, a month before its official opening.
goodnews.title: Coyote becomes first mammal seen using 101 wildlife crossing: 'This is amazing'

local.h: South Bronx, East New York lead in low-level tickets
local.b: A John Jay College analysis found more than 60% of NYPD loitering summonses since 2025 came from one South Bronx precinct.
local.title: South Bronx, East New York lead NYC in littering and panhandling tickets, analysis finds

local.h: Ex-FBI agent charged in Brooklyn hit-and-run
local.b: Prosecutors say Andrew Reyes hit a man in a Kensington crosswalk with his government car in February, left him unconscious on a bench and lied to investigators.
local.title: Feds accuse former FBI agent of Brooklyn hit and run, leaving victim on a bench

local.h: MTA chair sees better days with Democratic Congress
local.b: Janno Lieber said he expects more federal transit funding after the Trump administration repeatedly withheld money from New York and the MTA.
local.title: Better days ahead for NYC commuters with Democrats in control of Congress, MTA chair says

local.h: Ransomware attack hits Queens Public Library
local.b: Branches are open, but the website, computers, checkout machines and Wi-Fi are down.
local.title: Queens Public Library online system downed by ransomware hack, officials said

local.h: Lithium-ion battery found at Sunset Park fire
local.b: The discovery comes a week after an e-bike fire in Mott Haven killed four people.
local.title: Battery found at deadly Sunset Park fire days after similar blaze in Bronx

local.h: Elizabeth voters restore $20 rent-increase cap
local.b: The measure keeps the cap on future rent increases for at least a year.
local.title: $20 rent-control cap coming to Elizabeth, New Jersey

local.h: Sunset Park fire kills six
local.b: Seven others were hurt in the blaze at a two-story home on 58th Street; over 200 responders fought it.
local.title: Brooklyn fire kills 6 people, injures 9 others in Sunset Park, officials said

local.h: Street vendor tickets hit new highs
local.b: Parks enforcement tickets for unlawful vending rose 43% to 2,237, despite Mamdani's pledge of support.
local.title: Mamdani pledged support for NYC street vendors. Now they’re facing a crackdown.

local.h: Sanitation worker charged in Brooklyn crash death
local.b: Police say he struck and killed Siobhan Lynch, 30, while driving a garbage truck on Oct. 28.
local.title: DSNY worker arrested for killing a woman in Brooklyn while driving a garbage truck

local.title: French policemen to stand trial over 2020 beating of black man

local.h: Two Paris marches planned for Saturday
local.b: Major unions and the Yellow Vests have both called demonstrations in Paris on Nov. 7 after a week of school blockades and a national strike.
local.title: MAP: What to expect for the Paris protest on November 7th

local.h: Workers strike across France over wages
local.b: More than 250,000 marched in 73 cities against the rising cost of living, the CGT union said.

local.b: Saturday cost-of-living protests have drawn hundreds of thousands since Oct. 17, under tight security.

local.h: Four new airlines get Ryanair's Orly slots
local.b: Services to Germany, Lebanon, Moldova and Morocco are set to begin between April and October 2027.

local.h: Southern France on alert for heavy rain, floods
local.b: Hérault and Gard joined Corsica under orange alerts from 10am Thursday, Météo-France said.

local.h: Seattle rallies for trans girls after sports ban
local.b: Advocates marched from Westlake Park Thursday night after voters approved a measure restricting trans girls from girls' school sports.

local.h: Hood Canal rename paused after tribal objections
local.b: A state naming panel halted the proposal after Skokomish leaders said the tribe should weigh in on the change.
local.title: Effort to rename Hood Canal hits a fjordblock amid tribal opposition

local.h: Group weighs suit over trans sports ban
local.b: Gender Justice League says it may challenge, on privacy grounds, the ballot measure banning transgender girls from girls' school sports.
local.title: Lawsuits likely over Washington’s ban on trans girls in sports

local.h: Washington voters keep millionaires tax
local.b: Nearly 58% rejected repealing the high-earner income tax, and the repeal campaign conceded Thursday.

local.h: Spokane County deputy killed in firefight
local.b: A second deputy wounded at a home in Spangle is not expected to survive.

local.h: Seattle schools tighten access to YouTube, AI
local.b: The district is expanding limits on classroom screen time and personal devices.
